## Android and iOS (Platform; Japan)

- The ids and the official site: the official site's captures, https://web.archive.org/web/20151013060037/http://www.jp.square-enix.com/ff-agito/#news (Agito for Android and iOS, found by the user, with the store links) and https://web.archive.org/web/20150326014627/http://www.jp.square-enix.com/ff-agito/ff-agitoplus/ (AgitoPlus, the PS Vita version); the en.wikipedia page's external links point there
- https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.square_enix.android_googleplay.FFAgitoj -- the Android row -- accessed 2026-10-20
  - Gone. The row links the capture of 2015-11-28 (page text pasted by user, Swedish layout): https://web.archive.org/web/20151128155733/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.square_enix.android_googleplay.FFAgitoj
    - Version 3.0.5 of 2015-11-23, 7,061 ratings (3.4 stars), 100,000 to 500,000 installs, PEGI 16; the 3.0.5 note says an end-of-service function was added; the description announces the start of the second season (a new story from the beginning) and over a million downloads, and describes the school life plus war RPG: the world Orience, cadet candidates aiming to be the savior Agito, the Magic Academy life, season and birthday events, Kill Sight one-tap battles, and class points from missions and raid-style subjugation battles
- https://itunes.apple.com/jp/app/final-fantasy-agito/id774609884 -- the iOS row -- accessed 2026-10-20
  - Gone. The row links the capture of 2015-11-12 (version 3.0.4 of 2015-10-19, the live game; a review says the service ends in a month): https://web.archive.org/web/20151112001904/https://itunes.apple.com/jp/app/final-fantasy-agito/id774609884
  - Capture of 2015-10-02 (page text pasted by user): version 3.0.3 of 2015-06-17 adding the final story chapter and a character-appearance potion, 5,040 ratings over all versions, free with crystal purchases, iOS 7.0 or later, seller SQUARE ENIX Co., Ltd., rating 12+
  - The capture of 2016-08-26 shows version 3.0.5 with the end-of-service function, so the service ended after November 2015

## PlayStation Vita (AgitoPlus; scrapped)

- https://web.archive.org/web/20150326014627/http://www.jp.square-enix.com/ff-agito/ff-agitoplus/ -- the official page of AgitoPlus, the PS Vita version (capture of 2015-03-26, found by the user)
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Final_Fantasy_Agito -- accessed 2026-10-20 (text pasted by user): planned versions for the PlayStation Vita and Windows devices were scrapped, along with an announced localization; the successor, the online multiplayer game Final Fantasy Awakening, was released in 2016
- https://breezewiki.com/finalfantasy/wiki/Final_Fantasy_Agito#Development -- accessed 2026-10-20 (text pasted by user): a PS Vita version, Final Fantasy Agito+ (ファイナルファンタジーアギト プラス), was announced for later; originally scheduled for 2015-01-15, the date became TBA because of technical issues, and Square Enix announced its cancellation on 2015-09-17, later citing critical technical problems including server cross-compatibility and the multiplayer
  - A PS Vita row was added at the user's request and removed again the same day on that evidence; the description now names Final Fantasy Awakening (2016) as the successor

- The official site is the entry's `profileUrl` (user, 2026-10-20), the capture that links the store pages while the game was live: https://web.archive.org/web/20151013060037/http://www.jp.square-enix.com/ff-agito/
